records.title: Prepare to rent a student room
records.description: A person moving into a student room or other rented room needs a tenancy agreement and may need a municipal housing permit. Registration, contract, rent and local permit requirements must be checked for the actual address and tenancy arrangement.

official_source.title: Op kamers: wat moet ik regelen?

records.ai_summary: Before accepting a room, verify the tenancy agreement, address-registration possibility, rent and any municipal housing-permit requirement. Use the national guidance together with rules for the actual municipality and property.

attributes.municipality_caveat: Permit and address rules vary by municipality and property
